# Isaac Bigsby Trogdon

> Senior Software Engineer (Enterprise Web Platforms & AI Applications), Berlin, Germany. 15+ years building production Drupal/PHP platforms for enterprise clients; since 2022 focused on bringing LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and vector search into those platforms as maintained production features. Original author and maintainer of three officially released Drupal AI contrib modules.

## Key facts

- Current role: Senior Full-Stack Developer at LOOM GmbH (Berlin), Nov 2018–present, AI-focused since 2022.
- Open source: author/maintainer of ai_assistant_ui, ai_chatlog, and ai_insights — official Drupal.org contrib modules generalized from real production requirements.
- Core stack: PHP, Drupal (7–10), Symfony, Python (Flask), LangChain, OpenAI API, React, TypeScript, Qdrant, Milvus, Docker.
- Location: Berlin, Germany. Languages: English (native), German (fluent).
- Education: B.A. with Honors, Cultural Studies & German Studies, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill (1997–2002).
